barriers.reason: The son leaves home at 6:15 and is at work by 7, so he cannot drive the patient to an 8:00 AM West Side drop-off, and the patient cannot take the bus alone because she would get lost.

alternatives.text: Ask the adult day program whether drop-off can be later than 8:00 AM or whether a different day/schedule fits the son's work hours.
If the patient's condition prevents using fixed-route buses/trains, apply for ADA Paratransit certification (312-663-HELP) so she can get reserved rides to the program.
If the patient has Medicaid or dual coverage, check whether managed-care NEMT can cover rides to the adult day program; call the number on the back of the plan card.

barriers.reason: The son works Thursdays at 10 AM on a boiler and has no flexibility; attending would cost him wages.

alternatives.text: Ask the hospital whether the caregiver series is offered at another time/day, as a recorded or online session, or with printed materials he can review on his own schedule.
See whether any education session can be bundled with the patient's or son's existing clinic visits to avoid a separate Thursday trip.
